title: Einstein was right! Scientists verify 1st image of a black hole ever captured
caption:
The first image of a black hole wasn't just a fluke! An independent team used AI to re-analyze the data, confirming the original findings and proving Einstein’s theory of gravity correct.

Source: Space - Einstein was right! Scientists verify 1st image of a black hole ever captured
